smt-2023-geometry-tiebreaker-01.prompt: Let $\omega$ be a circle with radius $1$. Equilateral triangle $\triangle ABC$ is tangent to $\omega$ at the midpoint of side $BC$ and $\omega$ lies outside $\triangle ABC$. If line $AB$ is tangent to $\omega$, compute the side length of $\triangle ABC$.

smt-2023-geometry-tiebreaker-02.prompt: Triangle $\triangle ABC$ has side lengths $AB=3$, $AC=2$ and angle $\angle CBA=30^\circ$. Let the possible lengths of $BC$ be $l_1$ and $l_2$, where $l_2>l_1$. Compute $\frac{l_2}{l_1}$.

smt-2023-geometry-tiebreaker-03.prompt: Triangle $\triangle ABC$ has side lengths $AB=5$, $BC=8$, and $CA=7$. Let the perpendicular bisector of $BC$ intersect the circumcircle of $\triangle ABC$ at point $D$ on minor arc $BC$ and point $E$ on minor arc $AC$, and $AC$ at point $F$. The line parallel to $BC$ passing through $F$ intersects $AD$ at point $G$ and $CE$ at point $H$. Compute $\frac{[CHF]}{[DGF]}$. (Given a triangle $\triangle ABC$, $[ABC]$ denotes its area.)
